description: Default FDM profile. This is the profile the OLD check_printability hardcoded: wallMinMm 1.2 and overhangDeg 45 were literals in worker.py/inspect.ts. They are reproduced here with provenance `assumed` on purpose - they were never calibrated against a machine, and that is exactly what made them able to silently shape a design.

source.ref: inherited literal from check_printability; NOT calibrated

wallMinMm.detail: 2-3 extrusion widths. Calibrate with a wall-step coupon before trusting it.

overhangDeg.detail: Measured on a real part: 2022 mm2 of down-facing area on the delivered propeller.

source.ref: printed holes come out undersized; deeper than ~5:1 they close up

draftMinDeg.reason: FDM has no mold release; draft angle does not govern this process.

escapePassageMinMm.reason: No trapped medium to evacuate: material is deposited, not filled or sintered in a bed.

tolMm.detail: A capability, not a geometric fact: excluding on it needs a declared tolerance requirement.

surfaceRaUm.detail: Reported for information only. Never used to exclude.

notes: Every number above is `assumed` or `rule-of-thumb`. That is the honest state: this profile exists to make the inherited defaults VISIBLE, not to claim they are correct.
